sentences.text: Appearance:

Shri Ranjeet Singh Rawat - advocate for the petitione
 Shri Sammer Ghuriya - P.P. appearing on behalf of Adv
 Ms. Neha Bhadhoriya Advocate appeared for respondent.

Order 
This is Second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 126 of 2024 registered at Police Station Narwar, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offence under Section 376 (D), 305 of IPC and section 3, 4 of POCSO Act.

The first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 04/09/2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 32391/2024 with liberty to renew the prayer for bail after recording of the statements of witnesses Manoj and Kamal.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

It is further argued that after withdrawal of first bail application, statements of prosecution witnesses namely Manoj, Kamal and complainant Feran Singh have been recorded on 28/12/2024,
however, they have not supported the story of the prosecution and have turned hostile.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:347 2 MCRC-46406-2024
Under these circumstances, prosecution story becomes doubtful.

Charge sheet has since been filed, therefore,
further custodial interrogation of the applicant may not be required.
Applicant is the permanent resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.), therefore, there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant is in custody since 03/06/2024.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions imposed by this Court while granting bail.

On these grounds, he Chandrabhan Parihar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22026380/
1 prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
